name: Pool Fart
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Use the air pump to inflate the swim ring. Splash the cola on the man’s face.
Drag the crab onto his swim trunks.
Throw the wet sock at him.
Drop the gold bracelet into the pool.
Take a photo with the camera.
Spray the perfume over the water.
Tap the pool drain to create a distraction.
